title: Thai Fish Stir Fry
description: Quick and flavorful Thai-style fish stir fry made with succulent fish and crunchy vegetables. Serve with steamed rice for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillets
ingredients.notes: Fresh cod or snapper work well

ingredients.name: Savory
ingredients.notes: Use Thai-style savory or oyster sauce

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the sliced red chili pepper and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the fish fillets and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they start to flake apart.
Add the bamboo shoots, Thai basil, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Add the savory and oyster sauce (if using). Stir-fry for a final 2 minutes.
Serve the fish stir-fry hot, garnished with additional Thai basil and red chili pepper if desired.
